title: Football's final speed
description: Essential: The answer must state the football's speed after 2 seconds as 10 m/s.

title: Football's deceleration calculation
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Newton's second law to find the football's deceleration as 2 m/s².

title: Catch-up conclusion
description: Essential: The answer must conclude that the forward can catch up with the ball.

title: Catch-up time
description: Essential: The answer must state the catch-up time as 7 seconds.

title: Forward's motion phases
description: Important: The solution must analyze the forward's motion in two phases: acceleration to max speed and constant speed.

title: Football's stopping analysis
description: Important: The solution must calculate the football's total displacement (49 m) and time to stop (7 s).

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the football's deceleration is incorrectly treated as an acceleration (positive sign).

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Check that all calculations maintain consistent SI units (m, s, m/s, m/s²).
